# mcpgen documentation

mcpgen is a CLI that generates, extends, and verifies MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in Go.
Generated projects pin github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.8.0 and target MCP spec 2026-07-28.

Docs site: https://alesr.github.io/mcpgen/
Repository: https://github.com/alesr/mcpgen

## Machine-readable contract

Run `mcpgen schema` for the full CLI contract (commands, flags, exit codes, JSON envelope, mcpgen.json JSON Schema).
`mcpgen mcp` runs mcpgen as a stdio MCP server with tools mcpgen_new, mcpgen_add, mcpgen_check, mcpgen_schema.
Repo files for agents: AGENTS.md and SKILL.md in the repository root.
